2014_spells.tenser-s-transformation.effe: Deal 2d12 force damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.tenser-s-transformation.full: Using 1 action, until the spell ends, you can't cast spells, and you gain the following benefits: • You gain 50 temporary hit points. • When you hit a target with a weapon attack, that target takes an extra 2d12 force damage; • You have advantage on attack rolls that you make with simple and martial weapons. Until the spell ends, you can't cast spells, and you gain the following benefits: • You gain 50 temporary hit points; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
